name: SATX pair surplus skim
summary: SATX's transfer logic leaves surplus SATX in the SATX/WBNB pair above its reserves, which the attacker repeatedly harvested with skim() and sync() before withdrawing the pair's WBNB.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/satx.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: victim 0xFd80a436dA2F4f4C42a5dBFA397064CfEB7D9508 created 2024-01-24T14:38:05Z by 0x256db6a4f6f8b5310ad7d31bfbf629f9df406c0f, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xbef24b94c205999ea17d2ae4941ce849c9114bfd; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). The PoC header quotes the loss as ~999M SATX; measured from the exploit transaction the attacker nets 49.3396 WBNB, roughly USD 28K at April 2024 prices. 49.34 WBNB x $526.703478/BNB at the incident timestamp 1713283735 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $25,987.
